summary: NetEase, Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its notice of 2026 annual general meeting and proxy statement. The meeting, scheduled for June 23, 2026 in Hangzhou, China, includes routine items: re-election of six directors, ratification of auditors, and a general mandate to issue up to 10% of shares. No special-situation transaction—acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change—is disclosed. This is an ordinary AGM notice for a foreign private issuer, mapped to its U.S. equivalent proxy filing.
